answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an orchard header. Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a delta spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 92 answers an epoch hence burns 67 real forward passes, and the kernel record lets any auditor recompute the check. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
